requirements.statement: Validate requirement traceability before accepting a specification.
acceptance: Unknown IDs, duplicate IDs and uncovered requirements fail with nonzero exit.
Implemented features with unfinished tasks fail validation.

requirements.statement: Keep specification checks local, bounded and free of document-content diagnostics.
acceptance: Evidence paths cannot escape the repository or traverse symlinks.
Malformed and oversized documents produce bounded issue codes.
The draft generator refuses traversal and existing directories.

decisions.summary: Use versioned JSON for traceability and Markdown for reasoning; local regular-file checks, no dependencies or command execution.

tasks.summary: Implement traceability checking, CLI, draft generation and boundary regression tests.

checks.summary: Run semantic-reference, CLI and filesystem-boundary tests.
